base_dataset: ID reuses the corresponding synthetic I1-I100 workbooks; other mechanisms preserve base coordinates and required_robot

mechanisms.D-Bimodal: equiprobable Beta(2,8) and Beta(8,2), scaled by 0.3 + sample*(0.5n-0.1)
mechanisms.D-AntiDistance: assign sorted base deadlines in descending source_x+source_y order (stable sorting), then permute a uniform subset of max(2,ceil(0.30n)) deadlines
mechanisms.P-TruncNormal: normal processing times with range midpoint mean, sigma=0.1, rejection-sampled within the original type-specific range
mechanisms.P-Lognormal: lognormal processing times with original range midpoint mean and coefficient of variation 0.25
mechanisms.Joint: D-IID deadlines, then P-Lognormal processing times using the same random stream

base_distribution.distance: not computed by the instance generator
